description: Agiflow is a shared project board for turning plans into trackable work. Create projects, break them into work units and tasks, set priorities and statuses, assign work, add comments and attachments, and review progress across your workspace. Use Agiflow to plan launches, organize backlogs, run standups, triage incoming work, and keep decisions connected to the tasks they affect. Changes are saved to your authenticated Agiflow workspace, where your team can review and continue the work.
